_instructions: FOR CLAUDE (ignored by render.mjs and mix.mjs, which read only width, height, fps and duration): before writing any file of this reel, open progress/INDEX.md, progress/README.md and progress/REEL_FORMAT.md, and skills/code-video/SKILL.md.

Create progress/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<reel-name>/ at the start and save STATE, plan, caption lines (TXT), scene design and audio plan there as each step is done, never only at the end. Never write a half-finished reel into reels/<n>/.

The reel's files are index.html (window.render(t), window.__ready, and the lines written exactly as const TXT=[...];), video.json (this file), audio.json (optional) and post.json (title, description, instagram, thumbnailOffset). Names: letters, numbers, - and _ only. Width and height must be even.

Write ALL of the reel's files in ONE push_files commit, one reel per commit. That push starts the render and publishes to YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. Standing rule from the user: once the files are created, commit right away without waiting for approval. Then mark the job done in progress/INDEX.md and STATE.md.

PAGE CODE RULES THAT PREVENT A FAILED RUN (tts.mjs and render.mjs load index.html in headless Chromium and wait for window.__ready; one script error means a 60s timeout and a failed run): (1) Never declare a global const, let, var or function named top, parent, self, name, status, length, location, window, document, frames, history, event, open, close, stop, focus, blur, screen, origin or closed; use names like headT, nameTxt, topPx. (2) Never declare the same top-level name twice. (3) window.__ready = true must be the last statement and must always run. (4) Load nothing from the network: no CDN scripts, web fonts or remote images. (5) Keep the lines written exactly as const TXT=[...]; with valid JSON-style strings. (6) Keep all variables inside functions or one IIFE where possible.

Never edit an existing reel's video.json, audio.json or index.html just to add notes: that re-renders and re-posts it. Keep the voice Puck. Keep this _instructions key at the top of every new video.json.
